_about: Editorial data for the Poland country hub (/country/poland/) and its health page, written in task 175. Figures are never stored here: pages take them from src/data/profiles/POL.json and the generated series.
name: Poland

factChecks.against: RAC, Driving on the left or right across the world: Poland – R
factChecks.label: driving on the right

factChecks.against: Smartraveller Poland: fire and rescue 112, medical emergencies 112, police 997; FCDO Poland health page: call 112 and ask for an ambulance
factChecks.label: emergency numbers 112, or 997 for the police

verification.what: Every statistic row (value, year, world rank) on the page, every number in the text, title, description and JSON-LD, and every claim in the story and FAQ (ranks, comparisons, trends, our counts); the build also asserts each claim (assertClaim); driving side and emergency numbers by hand (factChecks)
verification.against: Original UN WPP 2024, UN WUP 2025 and World Bank WDI files read by scripts/verify/batch-175.py (independent of the site code); energy rows by check-energy and country facts by check-facts against their original files

verification.what: Every figure in the text, cards, Key facts, title, description, JSON-LD, statistic rows and every cell of the yearly table; every claim in the story, chart captions and FAQ (ranks, comparisons, trends, our counts)
verification.against: Original World Bank WDI files read by scripts/verify/batch-175.py; check-country-pages compares the table and CSV with the World Bank values
